stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]在恐怖主义融资的背景下,以下哪两项可能是非营利组织(NPO)被滥用的潜在迹象？(选择两项.)

options.A: 参与社区发展和人道主义援助项目
options.B: 来自匿名来源的大额且无法说明来源的现金捐赠
options.C: 在监管有限的高风险司法管辖区开展业务
options.D: 领导层和使命宣言频繁变化
options.E: 财务报告和治理实践高度透明

stem_en: In the context of terrorist financing, which of the following are potential indicators of the abuse of non-profit organizations (NPOs)? (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Involvement in community development and humanitarian aid projects.
options_en.B: Large and unaccounted cash donations from anonymous sources.
options_en.C: Operating in high-risk jurisdictions with limited oversight.
options_en.D: Frequent changes in leadership and mission statements.
options_en.E: Extensive transparency in financial reporting and governance practices.
